definition.rawMeanPickupPowerPerObservedOutputFrame: pickupSumSq / pickupSamples; combined L^2+R^2 per observed physics output frame while the layer exists, before limiter and bridge gain; not a per-channel mean or a full-window mean for newborn layers
definition.zDegree: count of incident positive compiled node-link pairs for this layer; link multiplicity, not unique neighboring-layer count
definition.zComponents: connected components of the layer-ID Z graph; a layer may itself contain disconnected planar subgraphs, so these are not full acoustic node components
definition.awakeFraction: awakeSamples / awakeSamplesCount; observer samples at 100-physics-step cadence
definition.nativeActivationEventsIncludingReinstall: raw observer activation counter includes topology installs; it cannot separate physical sleep-to-wake from reinstalls
definition.sleepTransitions: raw counter for awake-to-sleep events; unlike activations, topology reinstall does not increment it
definition.directStrikes: recounted from accepted schedule events; rendered history is [0,300 s), and frame 14,400,000 endpoint events are reported separately
definition.exposure: fraction of occupied source-grid cells routed to that layer at selected latest topology state <= window end

limits: No layerwise sum is called energy or audibility.
Readout does not separate direct excitation, indirect coupling, and retained state.
Native activation counters include topology reinstallation and do not identify physical sleep-to-wake events.
